headline: IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving pockets of strength.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit to high‑50% at Coforge. AI‑related revenue rose sharply at several firms, supporting profit gains at HCLTech and TCS. Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance, indicating pressure on margins. Overall, the sector remains positive but uneven.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue boost
themes.detail: AI revenue grew 29% at Infosys, 47% at LTM, and contributed $219 m at HCLTech.

themes.title: Margin and guidance pressure
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1‑2% and sees modest operating margin.

themes.title: High‑growth mid‑market players
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
